gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-numans: Floaty, friendly letters with generous gaps between every one of them. Nasalization is best at its short ascenders and caliper-shaped c; Numans, a sans, is best at widely tracked, rope-thick lowercase.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-khudawadi: Noto Sans Khudawadi keeps capitals and lowercase close in height. Neon does best at glowing, stylus-wide display lines, while Noto Sans Khudawadi does best at unlatched, quietly open rounds.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-modi: Glowing, stamped-metal letters that hold one line width throughout. Neon's single-width strokes sit against Noto Sans Modi, whose low capital-to-lowercase contrast and daylight in every curve make the pairing feel bright.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-multani: Hot, humming letters with nothing thin about them. Noto Sans Multani does best at lofty lowercase with a gaping e, while Neon does best at display lines with full-width joins.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noto-sans-newa: Vibrant from the first glance, Neon hums along in constant line width. Noto Sans Newa, with tall bowls and a clearly open e, reads smoothly paragraph after paragraph without tiring the eye.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-pathway-extreme: Glowing marker-nib lines in tall, stamped-metal lowercase, spaced generously throughout. Neon's line ignores direction entirely, while Pathway Extreme, a sans-serif, pairs stubby ascenders and descenders against a large x-height and clear round openings.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-radio-canada: Tall, glowing letters spaced out like stamped metal type. Neon excels at glowing, uniform line; Radio Canada, a sans, excels at tall, full c, s and z with clear curve endings.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-sono: Bright tube lettering with room to spare between glowing letters. Neon's true monoline drawing meets Sono, a sans with wide default spacing and a-shapes left ajar, and the shared looseness is what stands out.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-carrois-got: Letters pulled apart and glowing like neon tubes, geometric to the core. Neuropolitical is best at cut-out, router-bit strokes, while Carrois Gothic SC, a sans-serif, is best at clear curve endings and near-uniform heights.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-hind-vadoda: Wide-set, neon-tube letters with a geometric, glowing line. Neuropolitical is best at that pulled-apart display look, while Hind Vadodara is best at open-looking e and a shapes with tall bowls.
